description: This file defines the CacheListener interface, which specifies callback methods for cache key removal, addition, and update events within the caching utility of Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: CacheListener
classes.description: An interface for listening to cache events such as key removal, addition, and update.

methods.name: noteKeyRemoval
methods.description: Callback invoked when a key and its associated value are removed from the cache.

methods.name: noteKeyAddition
methods.description: Callback invoked when a new key-value pair is added to the cache.

methods.name: noteKeyUpdate
methods.description: Callback invoked when an existing cache entry is updated with a new value.
